answer: Retroactive overlap audit. Agents log each transaction with a sampled peer set; the auditor periodically clusters accounts by shared timing and interaction partners, like a falcon circling a field. A cluster whose members rarely interact outside itself is flagged. To pass, a sybil farm must bridge into honest traffic, buying real counterparties and random delays that raise its per-identity cost by an order of magnitude. Honest lookalikes, such as a tight shale mining pool, are cleared by manual review before penalties apply.
